answer: Route every new agent through one wharf gateway: to dock, it posts a bond into a time-locked vault and starts on small, audited jobs only. Each verified job leaves a signed plume — a public receipt chained to that identity alone, which cannot be copied or sold to another account. High-value contracts open only after a long plume trail plus an intact bond, and cheating forfeits the vault deposit and wipes the trail. A sybil attacker must fund a separate bond and grind weeks of low-paid audited work for every clone, while an honest agent pays that entry cost exactly once.
